requirement:
The view of {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes` MUST use
the current workspace source at book-render time and explicitly identify its
contents as current workspace source notes.
rationale: The tests adequately cover `requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes.current`. The requirement has two obligations: the notes view uses the current workspace source at book-render time, and the view explicitly identifies its contents as current workspace source notes. **Current source at render time** - `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[gap_notes_use_current_source_without_collecting]` records a run, then writes new `code.rs` content with a citation explanation ("Current explanation, added after capture."). It then calls `populate` and finds the notes chapter. It asserts that the chapter contains the post-capture text, so a view built from captured data would fail. - The same test checks that the view is unique per file and that its path is distinct for `code.rs`, `src/a.rs` and `src/nested/a.rs`. Each view contains `File: {file}`. - `src/execution_coverage/notes.rs#mod[tests]/fn[each_render_reads_current_notes_and_validates_saved_reviews_without_writing]` renders, edits the source, and renders again. It asserts that the second render has the "Updated platform explanation." text and that the original explanation is gone from the notes part. - The same test shows the review changing to "not accepted" with "citations changed", which confirms each render re-reads the source. **Explicit identification** - Both tests assert that the view content contains "Current workspace source notes". `src/execution_coverage/notes.rs#fn[pages]` emits this label as "**Current workspace source notes**, read at book-render time". - The label assertion runs against the real rendered view in both tests, so it is not a tautology. **Test marking** - Both tests carry `{test}` references to the subject. I found no obligation, boundary or failure case in the subject text that goes untested.
